title: CE-RISE Intelligent Circular Insights Workbench
description: An AI-assisted workbench for querying, validating, repairing and generating Digital Product Passport records. Answers cite supporting evidence or are declined when support is insufficient. Generated records are checked against the applied validation profile and include field-level support; repair keeps evidence-backed changes separate from unverified suggestions. A CE-RISE profile adds model-aware validation and structured evidence alongside a general-purpose profile.
